stem: Web conversion rose from 2.0% to 2.5% in a month when a paid social campaign was paused. Sessions fell by a fifth and orders stayed the same. What is the best reading of the rise?

options.text: Bigger baskets raised the order value, which lifted the rate
Returning customers placed more orders than the month before
Fewer low-intent sessions, not more orders, raised the rate
The checkout got easier, so more sessions ended in an order
